items.title: Level up your AI-powered game backend with Amazon DynamoDB new features
items.summary: The most difficult engineering problem when employing AI for gaming isn’t selecting the correct model—it’s selecting the infrastructure that supports the functionality needed to create compelling user experiences. A generative non-player character (NPC) that forgets every conversation, an AI dungeon master that loses narrative context mid-quest, or an agentic loop that drops state across an AWS Lambda cold start all produce sub-par experiences for the same reason: no durable, globally consistent state storage layer.
